consensus_findings.description: none: Migration 039 projection RPCs insert an unlabelled row, register its UUID in `work_queue_projection_ownership`, then apply the exact canonical label pair transactionally. `submit_task` and `reconcile_work_projection` insert with `labels=ARRAY[]::TEXT[]`, then `INSERT INTO work_queue_projection_ownership(task_id) VALUES(v_id) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING`, then `UPDATE work_queue SET labels=p_projection_labels WHERE id=v_id` (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:128-170, 251-314`). The `enforce_projection_label_ownership` trigger rejects post-migration unowned inserts/label updates (`338-357`). First-insert SSE works via `notify_projection_insert` trigger on the labelled UPDATE (`405-435`). Replay, concurrent generation serialization, and explicit administrator adoption of pre-039 rows all verified by live tests `test_same_generation_submit_replay_clears_noncanonical_owned_labels`, `test_owned_projection_cannot_take_over_unowned_issue_key`, `test_039_upgrade_fails_closed_until_owner_registers_verified_row`.

Critical: Production MCP and HTTP-proxy reconcile/submit surfaces cannot publish the adapter-owned label pair required by the OpenSpec. `QueueProjectionAdapter` always sends `projection_labels=['change:<id>','projection:autopilot-phase']` via the coordination bridge (`skills/autopilot/scripts/queue_projection.py:77-94`), but MCP `submit_work`/`reconcile_work_projection` and `http_proxy.proxy_submit_work`/`proxy_reconcile_work_projection` omit the field entirely (`agent-coordinator/src/coordination_mcp.py:322-423`, `agent-coordinator/src/http_proxy.py:473-525`). Direct MCP/service callers therefore cannot satisfy the labelled projection contract and fall onto the unlabelled SQL path audited in finding 1.

Nit: Unlabelled reconcile against an unowned reserved-labelled spoof aborts with `reserved_projection_label` (SQLSTATE 42501) instead of returning structured `projection_key_collision`. Because the cancel UPDATE lists `labels` as a target even when preserving OLD labels (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:287-297`), `enforce_projection_label_ownership` fires on the unowned spoof and raises (`:338-347`). A live probe confirmed the exception and that the head remained absent due to rollback; integrity holds accidentally, but callers get a privilege error rather than the documented collision reason.

none: Ordinary issue create/update rejects the reserved `projection:autopilot-phase` marker before persistence. `IssueService.create` and `IssueService.update` call `_reject_reserved_projection_label` which raises `ProjectionIssueMutationError` mapped to HTTP 403 in `coordination_api.py:1354-1355, 1445-1446, 1477-1478`. Database trigger `enforce_projection_label_ownership` (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:338-357`) rejects any INSERT/UPDATE supplying the marker before `work_queue_projection_ownership` registration. Verified by live test `test_database_rejects_unowned_spoofed_projection_issue` and HTTP test `test_ordinary_issue_api_cannot_cross_projection_boundary[create]`.

none: Ordinary issue update/close cannot mutate a registry-owned projection row. `mutate_issue_if_unowned` RPC (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:359-403`) takes a row lock (`FOR UPDATE`), checks `work_queue_projection_ownership` before applying any allowlisted patch, and returns `projection_issue_immutable` which the HTTP layer maps to 403 (`coordination_api.py:1445-1446, 1477-1478`). Verified by live tests `test_owned_same_generation_request_reactivates_terminal_canonical_issue` and HTTP test `test_ordinary_issue_api_cannot_cross_projection_boundary[update/close]`. The row-locking RPC closes check/write races for all patched fields and batched closes.

none: Keyed submit and reconcile authorize `publish_work_projection` in the service layer with the exact change resource and mode/change audit context. `WorkQueueService.submit` and `reconcile_projection` call `get_policy_engine().check_operation` with `operation="publish_work_projection"`, `resource=key.change_id`, and `context={"mode": "submit|reconcile", "change_id": key.change_id}` (`work_queue.py:777-798, 922-933`). HTTP layer `coordination_api.py:1204-1268` does the same before delegating to the service. Direct MCP/service callers cannot fall back to ordinary `submit_work` because the service layer itself selects the elevated operation when `projection_key` is present. Verified by test `test_standard_trust_cannot_publish_projection` returning HTTP 403.

none: Cedar policy mode resolves omitted trust through the same shared fail-closed resolver as native policy. `CedarPolicyEngine._do_check_operation` calls `resolve_trust_level` and on `TrustResolutionError` returns a deny decision without reaching mutation (`policy_engine.py:732-753`). Native policy does the same (`policy_engine.py:195-206`). Both engines deny before any mutating RPC. Verified by test `test_admin_resolves_trust_when_context_omits_it` and trust-resolution fail-open test `test_reconcile_propagates_instead_of_writing_unscanned`.

none: In-process `converge()` resolves the vendor panel using the reviewed `worktree_path` with explicit/local/coordinator/global precedence and retains SDK-only coordinator rosters. `convergence_loop.py:610-616` calls `_orchestrator_for_dispatch(None, worktree_path)` when `orchestrator` and `agents_yaml_path` are omitted, matching the fixed CLI dispatcher resolution chain. Regression test `test_converge_resolves_vendor_panel_from_reviewed_worktree` fails if the stale coordinator-first constructor is used.

none: Pre-registry N-to-N+1 fail-close is enforced. Both labelled SQL paths acquire `pg_advisory_xact_lock` then scan for associated unowned `projection:autopilot-phase` rows by payload `change_id` or exact `change:<id>` label, returning `projection_key_collision` before head or row mutation (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:97-112, 225-240`). Live test `test_039_upgrade_fails_closed_until_owner_registers_verified_row` proves migration-038 generation N blocks N+1 repair with head remaining `(INIT,0)` until explicit `work_queue_projection_ownership` registration.

none: Projection-head/ownership invariants hold. `work_queue_projection_heads` is updated atomically within the per-change advisory transaction. `work_queue_projection_ownership` is the sole ownership authority; mutable payload fields and labels cannot confer ownership. Active canonical rows preserve lifecycle state; owned terminal rows are reactivated to pending with lifecycle fields cleared and emit projection refresh event (`039_projection_integrity_and_insert_events.sql:161-175, 305-320`). Verified by live tests `test_owned_same_generation_replay_preserves_nonterminal_status`, `test_owned_same_generation_request_reactivates_terminal_canonical_issue`, `test_terminal_reactivation_refreshes_connected_sse` dissemination.

none: Canonical CLI persistence and ESCALATE resume work correctly. `runner.py init`, `transition`, `escalate`, `apply-outcome`, `record-state-only-archetype`, and `project-state` commands persist state before projection (design D8). `enter_escalate` increments `total_iterations` exactly once. Console-approved `escalate_resume` applies the canonical `resolved` edge before host projection. Resume reconciliation runs before gates/work. Verified by autopilot test suites: `test_apply_outcome_contract.py` (40 tests), `test_runner_cli.py` (15 tests), `test_console_interviewer.py` (10 tests).

none: Connected-client visibility via SSE works for first-insert, reconciliation, and terminal reactivation. Migration 037 emits label-update events; migration 039 emits first-insert event via `notify_projection_insert` trigger. `event_stream.py` converts both to SSE snapshot replacement. Verified by live tests `test_connected_sse_refreshes_after_atomic_projection_reconciliation`, `test_connected_sse_refreshes_for_first_canonical_projection_insert`, `test_terminal_reactivation_refreshes_connected_sse` — all complete within 1 second.

none: Coordinator-free isolation is preserved. `QueueProjectionAdapter` is constructed only for coordinated hosts; `runner.py project-state` imports it lazily. Local-parallel and sequential tiers perform zero projection-module imports/construction and zero projection submit/reconcile/label-helper calls. Isolation test `test_phase_projection_isolation.py` fails closed if `try_submit_work`, `try_reconcile_work_projection`, or coordinator-only label helpers are imported or called from free tiers. Pre-existing coordinator detection/archetype resolution imports are retained per D10.

none: Local MCP `db` transport reaches `WorkQueueService.submit`/`reconcile_projection` which authorize `publish_work_projection` in the service layer with the exact change resource and mode/change audit context when a projection is submitted or reconciled. Direct MCP callers cannot fall back to ordinary `submit_work`. Verified by service test `test_service_layer_elevates_keyed_submit_and_reconcile`.

none: Ordinary issue create/update rejects `projection:autopilot-phase` in `IssueService` (`issue_service.py:44-53,274,425`); update/close mutate only through row-locking `mutate_issue_if_unowned` which FOR UPDATEs the issue, refuses registry-owned UUIDs and reserved-label patches, then allowlists all patched fields (`039_...sql:359-401`; `issue_service.py:461-518`). HTTP maps `ProjectionIssueMutationError` to 403 (`coordination_api.py:1354-1355,1445-1446,1477-1478`). Live tests `test_reserved_projection_rows_are_database_owned_and_issue_immutable` and `test_database_rejects_unowned_spoofed_projection_issue` passed.

none: Pre-registry labelled N-to-N+1 fail-close holds on both labelled SQL paths under the advisory lock (`039_...sql:98-112,226-239`); live upgrade test kept head at INIT/0 and refused submit/reconcile until explicit ownership registration. Canonical CLI persistence and ESCALATE resume hold: `runner.py` init/transition/escalate persist before `project-state`; `enter_escalate` increments `total_iterations` once (`autopilot.py:514-525`); resume reconciles before work (`autopilot.py:1058-1059`). Connected SSE visibility for first insert, reconcile, and terminal reactivation passed live. Coordinator-free isolation holds (`test_phase_projection_isolation.py`).

FYI: Local MCP issue create/update/close catch `ProjectionIssueMutationError` as generic `Exception` and return `success:false` with `ProjectionIssueMutationError: <reason>` while logging (`coordination_mcp.py:551-567,699-714,756-766`), whereas HTTP returns 403. The row is still unchanged; only the authorization failure envelope differs from the HTTP issue API contract.
